description:
[Trading Data API] Native-token balance (ETH/POL) for any address or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon — Native-token balance (ETH/POL) for any address or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Live from the chain over redundant RPCs — wei plus formatted units.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-balance?address=vitalik.eth&chain=ethereum`

address.description: Required. A 0x address or an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_balance
